author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Eight! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Another FREE TO PLAY game today with a wonderful kid-friendly love letter to the turn-based strategy JRPG games of the 80s and 90s with FLAK ARCANA. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game and rosters for FREE HERE: https://kabewski-games.itch.io/flak-arcana
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 088 - Flak Arcana by Kabewski
